title: Values at tracked tape slots
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $\alpha$ be a type, and assign argument and capture values in $\alpha$ and data, visited-mark, and origin-mark values in $\alpha$ to each source tape. For every source tape $i$ and every component $r$ among data, visited marks, and origin marks, the layout at the physical index for component $r$ of tape $i$ equals that tape's assigned value for the corresponding component.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
argument and capture values lie in $\alpha$
data, visited-mark, and origin-mark values in $\alpha$ are assigned to every source tape
$r$ is one of the three tracked components
replaced:
For every assignment of per-slot values and every source tape $i$, the clean-call layout
evaluated at the physical index of component $r$ of bank $i$ gives the data value, the
visited value, or the origin value of tape $i$ according to $r$.
